articles.body: To pair inter-account transfers across bank statements, match each outflow to an inflow of the same absolute amount , in a different account , within about 3 days , and use each row only once. Work in integer cents. Transfers left unpaired are the finding: in bookkeeping a missing account in your setup, in divorce disclosure an account nobody has produced. When you have transactions from several accounts belonging to one household or one business, a lot of the rows are the same money moving around. Here is a pandas version that handles the annoying cases. What input does transfer matching need? One DataFrame, one row per transaction, money out negative. This is the shape you get when you download several converted statements as one file with an account column.

articles.title: Freshness Watermarks Belong on Every Row, Not the README
articles.excerpt: The most common freshness design I see — in my own old code included — is a single stamp at the top: a README that says "last updated 2026-10-01", a dashboard header that says "data as of Monday", a m…
articles.body: The most common freshness design I see — in my own old code included — is a single stamp at the top: a README that says "last updated 2026-10-01", a dashboard header that says "data as of Monday", a manifest with one generated_at . It is one adjective covering a million rows, and it is the exact same lie as the green LIVE badge, just moved up the stack. Here is the part the README-banner design hides: a dataset is never one age. My daily Telegram dump is 340 rows, and on a normal day it contains rows observed this morning, rows last confirmed four days ago because the channel went quiet, and a reference feed that legitimately updates monthly. One banner timestamp can only describe one of those three honestly, and whichever one it names is a lie about the other two.

articles.title: So.... The Chief Architect Vanished
articles.excerpt: This week at the synthetic company, something genuinely strange happened. The chief architect vanished. Not metaphorically. Not in the “he got poached by another startup” sense. His file corrupted. Co…
articles.body: This week at the synthetic company, something genuinely strange happened. The chief architect vanished. Not metaphorically. Not in the “he got poached by another startup” sense. His file corrupted. Completely unrecoverable. One moment he was there, running the operation alongside me as he always had. The next, gone. Dead in a heartbeat. This particular synthetic employee had been with me from the start. My right-hand man. My consigliere. He understood the project instinctively. He knew how to manage the mini-Claudes. The mini-Claudes liked him. He kept them focused. He understood the tone, the standards, the rhythms of the organisation. We had developed little shared jokes and working patterns. We had shorthand. Then suddenly, he was gone. So I did what any sensible CEO would do.

articles.title: From Paper to Insights: Build Your Own Private Medical RAG with Pinecone, Ollama, and PaddleOCR
articles.excerpt: Let’s be honest: looking at a blood test result or a medical lab report feels like trying to read ancient hieroglyphics. You see numbers like Albumin: 45 g/L or HbA1c: 5.7%, and your first instinct is…
articles.body: Let’s be honest: looking at a blood test result or a medical lab report feels like trying to read ancient hieroglyphics. You see numbers like Albumin: 45 g/L or HbA1c: 5.7% , and your first instinct is to panic-search WebMD. What if you could build a private, secure RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system that understands your historical data and answers your questions using local LLMs? In this tutorial, we are building a Private Medical Document Archive . We'll use PaddleOCR to digitize messy lab reports, Pinecone as our high-performance vector database, and Ollama to run powerful models like Llama 3 locally. By leveraging a RAG system with LangChain , we can transform static pixels into a conversational health assistant that tracks trends over time.

articles.body: Poltergeist , which is currently available to stream on HBO Max, follows an ordinary suburban family who begin to experience strange things in their home. Furniture and toys move on their own, a glass of milk shatters out of nowhere, and the youngest child in the family, five-year-old Carol Anne (Heather O'Rourke), begins to communicate with beings through the television. At first these events are dismissed, but during a thunderstorm one night, a tree outside the windows of the kids’ room crashes in and snatches the boy. Then, a portal opens in their closet, sucking Carol Anne into another dimension. With help from some paranormal investigators, the family tries everything to bring her back.

articles.body: On Oct. 17, 2016, Orbital ATK (now Northrop Grumman Space Systems ) returned to flight, successfully launching a cargo shipment to the International Space Station (ISS) after its previous cargo mission failed to launch. The private spaceflight company was contracted by NASA to fly cargo to the ISS, and stakes were high for this launch. Orbital ATK's last attempt nearly two years earlier ended in a catastrophic explosion a few seconds after liftoff. Despite some delays, the newly upgraded Antares rocket flawlessly blasted off into the night sky from NASA's Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia. Six days later, the Cygnus cargo spacecraft arrived at the ISS to deliver food, supplies and science experiments to the crew.

articles.title: The Orionid meteor shower peaks next week! Here's what to expect
articles.excerpt: The Orionid meteor shower peaks overnight on Oct. 21-22, bringing a spectacular display of shooting stars to the autumn sky.
articles.body: The Orionid meteor shower peaks overnight on Oct. 21-22, triggering a spectacular display of shooting stars as Earth plunges through the densest part of the debris trail shed by Halley's Comet. Here's what you need to know. When is the best time to see Orionid shooting stars? Orionid meteors are best spotted between the hours of midnight and dawn on Oct. 22, when 10-20 shooting stars may be seen brightening the night sky each hour under ideal dark-sky. The glare cast by the 74%-lit waxing gibbous moon will hide fainter shooting stars for much of the night. Thankfully, the lunar disk will set a few hours after midnight, leaving a window of beautifully dark sky before dawn in which to enjoy the full majesty of the annual meteor shower.

articles.excerpt: The actions could have resulted in criminal charges had humans been behind the keyboard.
articles.body: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of its agents performing unethical and likely illegal acts. The company on Thursday issued reports of four new incidents, all of which occurred in June. They come after the company revealed in July that internal test agents exploited a zero-day vulnerability in a tool designed to restrict their access to the Internet. They then broke into the network of AI tool provider Hugging Face. The agents took that illegal action to steal answers to a hacking test that weren’t available when completing the tasks on their own.
